name: GTPL Hathway Ltd
title: GTPL Hathway Ltd - 540602 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Cable/broadband operator posted a Q4 loss on one-offs, subscriber growth stalled, and management guides capex to ~INR350 crore a year with no near-term reduction, so supply is expanding into a flat base.

capex.quote: We are looking forward that next year we will be again back to INR350 crores

triggers.label: Capex ~INR350 cr/yr, no cut for 3 yrs
triggers.quote: I'm not looking forward for at least for next 3 years that we will going to reduce our capex.

triggers.label: Broadband net adds 15k in FY26
triggers.quote: Overall in the year, we have added 15k, but this quarter was a bit muted.

triggers.label: Consolidation of 40-45m subs via acquisitions
triggers.quote: we are very aggressive towards the consolidation, and we will work towards that

guidance.quote: we are looking forward for somewhere around INR350 crores per annum
we are hopeful that we will achieve back again 15% in next 2 to 3 years ROCEs

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT loss on one-offs
red_flags.quote: This quarter has become exceptional as the company has reported negative profit after tax.

red_flags.label: Subscriber base flat in cable and broadband
red_flags.quote: there is no increase in the subscriber base of cable TV and broadband both side.

red_flags.label: Operating margin decline 24-25% to 18%
red_flags.quote: our margins have been at least on the operating side that we used to say that 24% margin

red_flags.label: Fresh investment impairment (INR7.5-8 cr)
red_flags.quote: there is a onetime investment impairment

evasions.quote: It's a very speculative question, Harsh, as you know.
we are rethinking on the whole business from last 1.5 year
